question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Powerful
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Powerful"** means **having great power or strength.** (शक्तिशाली)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a** powerful** leader who inspires many people.
 
 
 
• **"Impotent"** refers to **lacking power or ability; unable to take effective action. **(अशक्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The government seemed** impotent** in the face of the economic crisis.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Powerful'** is **'Impotent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wild** (जंगली): Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

 
 
• **Example:** The** wild** animals roamed freely in the forest.
 
 
 
• **Strong** (मजबूत): Having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.
 
 
• **Example: **He is **strong **enough to lift the heavy box by himself.
 
 
 
• **Manly** (मर्दाना): Having qualities traditionally associated with men, such as strength or courage.
 
 
• **Example:** He showed a **manly** determination to overcome the challenges.
